handoff.salientSummary: Implemented Secret manager for API keys (OpenAI, Claude, Qwen) with base64 encoding, owner references to Job, and secure file-based mounting instead of env vars to prevent key exposure in logs.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created Secret manager package (internal/k8s/secret/) with SecretManager struct that creates K8s Secrets with base64 encoded API keys (OpenAI, Claude, Qwen). Secrets have owner references to Job for garbage collection. Provided VolumeMount and Volume helpers to mount keys as files at /etc/api-keys (not as env vars to prevent key exposure in logs). KeyToPathItems() provides mappings to friendly filenames. Security check IsKeyExposedInData() detects raw (non-base64) key patterns.
